Question: Address-bar fallback (no Document has a portal URL): which Documents are read?
Choice: Only on-screen Documents that give no URL of their own; a Document whose own URL is off the portals is never read
Why: WP3 text said every on-screen Document; that would read an Edge sidebar or extension pane whenever the main page exposes no URL. Same coverage for browsers without a Document URL, no privacy leak.

Question: R9: how is a page known to be heavy, and how are worker threads made?
Choice: Last read ms per lane per ctx.url (50 kept); unknown pages are not held. Each worker is a one-thread daemon executor, not ThreadPoolExecutor
Why: R9 says the last read of that page; a URL key needs no new field. ThreadPoolExecutor threads are joined at exit, so a wedged UIA call would hold the app open; daemon threads satisfy 'close() leaves wedged threads daemon'.

Question: R7 vs the WP3 move of extract_browser_url into vsdc_uia_text
Choice: address_bar_here holds the code; VSDCRouter.extract_browser_url stays and delegates to it with its own _uia and _cached_address_elements
Why: One copy so the two readers cannot drift; the crosshair path keeps its method, object and cache exactly as R7 requires (its tests unchanged and green).

Question: WP4 text says delete the router's own URL read and remove burst ticks; what was done?
Choice: Router keeps _init_uia, extract_browser_url, _cached_address_elements and its 15 ms burst ticks for the crosshair engines only; while SGT is on the worker skips burst ticks and the capture loop bursts its own reads (BURST_READS=3, 0.3 s apart)
Why: R7 overrides the deletion; burst ticks only served the crosshair OCR engine, and with SGT on a 15 ms tick would add screenshots, not reads

Question: Frame tick and the OCR flash trigger in WP4
Choice: FRAME_TICK_SEC=0.35 (worker default), FRAME_TICK_FAST_SEC=0.2 named; OCR flash read not wired (WP7), the loop keeps screenshotting during a heavy read so WP7 can fire it
Why: R10: 0.2 s only after WP0's gate probe measures a tick under 15 ms; WP7 owns the flash trigger and FLASH_MIN_CELLS

Question: How does the loop keep the URL fresh (R2) and hand reads to today's SGT?
Choice: A URL-only read is asked once the window's URL is 1 s old (SCOPE_POLL_SEC < URL_FRESH_SEC 2 s); a page read is handed to SgtShadow.observe(read={lines,docs,ms}) under the read's own URL, tab and title (_absorb_compat, deleted by WP5); torn and error results are never absorbed (R1)
Why: polling at half the freshness limit keeps the scope gate open without a gap; observe(read=) reuses the whole existing SGT path with no second read
